'''Null gas''' was a type of gas that neutralized [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] in the air, suffocating oxygen-breathing species. [[Xufal D'uat]] adapted the life support of the cells in his ship, [[Twi'lek Dancer|''Venom Sting'']], with canisters of null gas to knock down his prisoners. This customization was to the liking of later owners of the ship, a team of [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]].
